facts.text: The Royal-Riviera is a five-star hotel in the heart of Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat on the Cote d'Azur.
facts.excerpt: The Royal-Riviera Hotel is a five-star hotel in the heart of Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat, an iconic location on the Côte d’Azur.

facts.text: The hotel sits on the Cap-Ferrat peninsula with access to the beach and overlooks Provencal gardens, mountains and the Mediterranean sea.
facts.excerpt: With a prime spot on the Cap-Ferrat peninsula with access to the beach, the hotel overlooks Provençal gardens and mountains as well as the sparkling Mediterranean sea.

facts.text: The rooms are designed to reflect the landscape of the south of France, and most of them overlook the sea and gardens.
facts.excerpt: Designed to reflect the landscape of the south of France, the majority of the rooms overlook the sea and gardens.

facts.text: A private villa, l'Orangerie, holds additional rooms and suites decorated in Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat style.
facts.excerpt: The private villa l’Orangerie features 18 additional rooms and Suites decorated in the purest Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat style.

facts.text: The Orangerie deluxe rooms all have either a balcony or a terrace.
facts.excerpt: Bright and spacious, all equipped with either balcony or terrace, the deluxe rooms of the Orangerie reflect entirely the spirit of the Mediterranean.

facts.text: The outdoor pool is free for hotel guests and has a pool bar where guests can sip a cocktail with their feet in the water.
facts.excerpt: access is free for hotel guests, who can also take the time to sip a cocktail with their feet in the water thanks to our pool bar.

facts.text: The outdoor pool is heated.
facts.excerpt: Outdoor heated pool

facts.text: The Wellness Center offers treatments from the THALGO marine range.
facts.excerpt: Rejuvenate in our Wellness Center where you can test the THALGO range of treatments, the expert in Marine Intelligence.

facts.text: The hotel's sandy beach is open from mid-May to the end of September.
facts.excerpt: Discover the Royal-Riviera sandy beach, opens from mid-May to end of September.

facts.text: Water sports at the beach are offered by partner Cap-Ferrat Watersports.
facts.excerpt: water sports activities offered by our partner Cap-Ferrat Watersports

facts.text: Jasmin Grill & Lounge is centered around a wood-fired grill.
facts.excerpt: at Jasmin Grill & Lounge, centered around our wood-fired grill.

facts.text: Children up to 12 stay free when sharing their parents' room.
facts.excerpt: Free stay for kids sharing parent’s room until 12 years old.

facts.text: There is no kids' club; children's activities are not supervised by hotel staff.
facts.excerpt: (No Kids’ Club – activities not supervised by hotel staff)

facts.text: Children aged 7 to 12 can join a treasure hunt at the Villa Ephrussi de Rothschild.
facts.excerpt: Treasure Hunt at the Villa Ephrussi de Rothschild (7-12 years old)

facts.text: Buckets and spades are available at the hotel's private beach.
facts.excerpt: Buckets and spades available at the Royal-Riviera private beach

facts.text: Junior Suites with panoramic sea view have a large marble bathroom with natural daylight and separate bath and shower.
facts.excerpt: Large marble bathroom with natural daylight, bath & shower separated.

facts.text: Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat is an old fishing village that became a seaside and winter resort sought after for its serenity.
facts.excerpt: An old fishing village, Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat is a seaside and winter resort ideally located and much sought after for its serenity.

facts.text: Sights in the village include the port, the 18th-century Chapelle Sainte-Hospice and the Vierge Noire.
facts.excerpt: Also worth seeing: the village, the port, the 18th century Chapelle Sainte-Hospice and the Vierge Noire.

facts.text: The hotel has a fitness area with a sauna and steam room.
facts.excerpt: Fitness   Sauna & Steam Room

facts.text: Extra beds are available in Deluxe rooms, Junior Suites and Suites.
facts.excerpt: (extra bed available in Deluxe rooms, Junior Suites and Suites)
